services.name: Campsite
services.desc: There are 13 walk-to waterfront sites that sit on or very close to the river's edge. These are the most desirable sites in the campground with the gently rolling river only a few feet away. The store, bathhouse, and parking are within easy walking distance. Sites 28-32 sit 8' to 12' above the water on a very steep bank. Because of the steep bank, we do not recommend this area for families with toddlers or young children who may be at risk for falling. Sites 22, 23, & 24 are not drive-to and do not provide water or electric hook-up. Sites 23, and 24 are considered small sites and only allow for one tent. services.name: Rv Sites
services.desc: We have 8 sites along the campground road that are ideal for pop-up campers and provide optional water and electric hook-ups. The playground, bathhouse, and general store are close by for convenience. Some of these sites have a view of the river while others offer limited river viewing during the foliage season. RV sites are located along the upper level of the campground near the bathhouse. Although the river is not visible from the RV sites, you cannot escape the sound of the spring water carving its way down the mountainside. Important information regarding the RV sites: They are not pull-through, they are back-in with full hook-ups. We can only accommodate RVs up to 25 feet in length
